name: Maner
reviewOutcome: Official Bihar cadastral custodian and public viewer are evidenced, but anonymous parcel-vector integration is unqualified.
custodianAssessment: Bihar Government Revenue and Land Reforms Department and Directorate of Land Records & Survey are the evidenced custodians. BhuNaksha Bihar is a public cadastral map viewer; no general national agency prose was used as local registry evidence.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries found Bihar Bhumi and BhuNaksha. Current public hierarchy requests exposed Patna–Danapur–Maner and village/map choices.
requestOutcomes: Landing HTML, viewer JavaScript/configuration, hierarchy count/list REST routes, and the documented plot/WMS routes were inspected. Hierarchy JSON was retrieved, but no safe native parcel ID plus unchanged geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was not forced into a sheet or converted into a false parcel lookup.
endpointInspection: Viewer JavaScript showed rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel, rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY, rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref, and WMS. The viewer is WMS-oriented; no public vector schema or geometry-bearing anonymous response was verified.

geometryEvidence.reason: No unchanged native parcel geometry response was received.

scopeLimits: A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, or unselected sheet is not evidence of citywide absence.
Hierarchy presence does not establish citywide polygon completeness, administrative-boundary alignment, or coverage across all Maner sheets/villages.
WMS display evidence is not retained parcel-vector geometry and does not establish a stable native parcel identity for runtime use.
No source integration, adapter qualification, or admission is claimed.
uncertainty: Moderate for existence of an official Bihar/Maner cadastral map service; high for anonymous vector geometry availability, citywide coverage, and parcel identity behavior.
recommendedDisposition: Hold for serial reviewer retry with independent sheet discovery and adapter qualification.
